definition: to have enough money to pay for something
example: I can't afford a new laptop right now.
exampleEs: Ahora mismo no puedo permitirme una laptop nueva.
cloze: I can't ____ a new laptop right now.
note: Usually with can/can't/could. No 'to' needed before the noun.

definition: to stay away from something or stop it from happening
example: Try to avoid meetings without an agenda.
exampleEs: Intenta evitar las reuniones sin agenda.
cloze: Try to ____ meetings without an agenda.
note: Avoid is followed by -ing, never by 'to': avoid making, not avoid to make.

definition: to succeed in doing or getting something after effort
example: She worked hard to achieve her goal.
exampleEs: Trabajó duro para lograr su meta.
cloze: She worked hard to ____ her goal.

definition: to try very hard to do something that is difficult
example: I still struggle with the past perfect.
exampleEs: Todavía batallo con el pasado perfecto.
cloze: I still ____ with the past perfect.
note: Say struggle WITH a problem or struggle TO do something.

definition: to trust someone or something to do what you need
example: You can rely on me to finish the report.
exampleEs: Puedes confiar en que terminaré el reporte.
cloze: You can ____ on me to finish the report.
note: Always rely ON, not 'rely in'.

definition: to take action to solve a problem or handle a situation
example: We need to deal with this bug before the release.
exampleEs: Tenemos que ocuparnos de este bug antes del lanzamiento.
cloze: We need to ____ with this bug before the release.
note: Not 'deal to' or 'deal about'. The past tense is dealt.

definition: to understand something or find the answer by thinking
example: I can't figure out why the test keeps failing.
exampleEs: No logro averiguar por qué la prueba sigue fallando.
cloze: I can't ____ out why the test keeps failing.
note: Informal and very common at work. With a pronoun, split it: figure it out.

definition: good enough to deserve the money, time or effort spent
example: This course is worth the money.
exampleEs: Este curso vale lo que cuesta.
cloze: This course is ____ the money.
note: Worth is followed by a noun or an -ing verb: worth reading, not worth to read.

definition: to get better or to make something better
example: I want to improve my listening skills.
exampleEs: Quiero mejorar mis habilidades de comprensión auditiva.
cloze: I want to ____ my listening skills.
note: Not 'to better'. Improve is the normal verb.

definition: to succeed in doing something difficult
example: She managed to fix the bug in ten minutes.
exampleEs: Logró arreglar el bug en diez minutos.
cloze: She ____ to fix the bug in ten minutes.
note: Manage to + verb means you succeeded. It is not the same as 'administrar'.

definition: to offer an idea or plan for someone to consider
example: I suggest moving the meeting to Friday.
exampleEs: Sugiero mover la reunión al viernes.
cloze: I ____ moving the meeting to Friday.
note: Say suggest doing, never 'suggest to do'. You also can't say 'suggest me'.

definition: to be decided by or to change according to something else
example: It depends on the budget.
exampleEs: Depende del presupuesto.
cloze: It ____ on the budget.
note: Always depend ON. 'It depends' is a complete answer.

definition: to think that something will happen
example: I expect the results to be ready tomorrow.
exampleEs: Espero que los resultados estén listos mañana.
cloze: I ____ the results to be ready tomorrow.
note: Expect is not 'esperar' as in waiting. For waiting use wait for.

definition: to suddenly understand or notice something
example: I just realized I forgot to send the invoice.
exampleEs: Acabo de darme cuenta de que olvidé enviar la factura.
cloze: I just ____ I forgot to send the invoice.
note: False friend: realize usually means darse cuenta, not 'realizar' (do or carry out).

definition: to see or become aware of something
example: Did you notice the typo in the title?
exampleEs: ¿Te fijaste en el error de dedo en el título?
cloze: Did you ____ the typo in the title?

definition: to make something smaller in amount or size
example: We want to reduce the loading time.
exampleEs: Queremos reducir el tiempo de carga.
cloze: We want to ____ the loading time.

definition: to become bigger in amount or to make something bigger
example: Sales increased by 20 percent last quarter.
exampleEs: Las ventas aumentaron un 20 por ciento el trimestre pasado.
cloze: Sales ____ by 20 percent last quarter.
note: Use by for the amount of change: increased by 20 percent.

definition: to need something or to make something necessary
example: This job requires good communication skills.
exampleEs: Este trabajo requiere buenas habilidades de comunicación.
cloze: This job ____ good communication skills.
note: Formal. In speech, 'you need' is more common.

definition: to give or supply something that people need
example: The company provides free lunch for employees.
exampleEs: La empresa ofrece almuerzo gratis a sus empleados.
cloze: The company ____ free lunch for employees.
note: Structure: provide something TO someone, or provide someone WITH something.

definition: to include something as a necessary part
example: The project involves three different teams.
exampleEs: El proyecto involucra a tres equipos distintos.
cloze: The project ____ three different teams.
note: Be involved IN an activity.

definition: to have the same opinion as someone
example: I agree with your point about the schedule.
exampleEs: Estoy de acuerdo con tu punto sobre el calendario.
cloze: I ____ with your point about the schedule.
note: No 'am agree'. Say I agree. Agree WITH a person, ON a topic, TO a plan.

definition: to ask formally for a job, a place or permission
example: I'm going to apply for a new position.
exampleEs: Voy a postularme a un nuevo puesto.
cloze: I'm going to ____ for a new position.
note: Apply FOR a job, apply TO a company.

definition: to pick one thing from several options
example: It's hard to choose between two good offers.
exampleEs: Es difícil elegir entre dos buenas ofertas.
cloze: It's hard to ____ between two good offers.
note: Irregular: choose, chose, chosen.

definition: to make a choice after thinking
example: We decided to launch the app in March.
exampleEs: Decidimos lanzar la app en marzo.
cloze: We ____ to launch the app in March.
note: Decide + to + verb. Decide ON a choice.

definition: to say that something is good or suggest that someone do it
example: Can you recommend a good book about psychology?
exampleEs: ¿Puedes recomendarme un buen libro sobre psicología?
cloze: Can you ____ a good book about psychology?
note: Say recommend doing, not 'recommend to do'.

definition: to say something briefly
example: She mentioned a problem with the server.
exampleEs: Mencionó un problema con el servidor.
cloze: She ____ a problem with the server.
note: No preposition: mention something, not 'mention about'.

definition: to give details so someone can understand
example: Can you explain how this function works?
exampleEs: ¿Puedes explicar cómo funciona esta función?
cloze: Can you ____ how this function works?
note: Say explain it TO me, not 'explain me'.

definition: to like one thing more than another
example: I prefer working in the evening.
exampleEs: Prefiero trabajar por la noche.
cloze: I ____ working in the evening.
note: Prefer A TO B, not 'prefer A than B'.

definition: to let someone do something
example: The app doesn't allow you to edit comments.
exampleEs: La app no te permite editar comentarios.
cloze: The app doesn't ____ you to edit comments.
note: Allow someone TO do something.

definition: to stop something from happening
example: Good sleep can prevent burnout.
exampleEs: Dormir bien puede prevenir el agotamiento.
cloze: Good sleep can ____ burnout.
note: Prevent someone FROM doing something.

definition: to be present at an event or class
example: Did you attend the meeting yesterday?
exampleEs: ¿Asististe a la reunión de ayer?
cloze: Did you ____ the meeting yesterday?
note: False friend: attend means asistir, not 'atender'. No 'to' after it.

definition: to help someone or something to succeed
example: Our team will support you during the migration.
exampleEs: Nuestro equipo te apoyará durante la migración.
cloze: Our team will ____ you during the migration.

definition: to think carefully about something before deciding
example: Have you considered changing jobs?
exampleEs: ¿Has considerado cambiar de trabajo?
cloze: Have you ____ changing jobs?
note: Consider is followed by -ing: consider moving, not 'consider to move'.

definition: to move an event to a later time
example: We had to postpone the launch.
exampleEs: Tuvimos que posponer el lanzamiento.
cloze: We had to ____ the launch.
note: Postpone is the usual word for moving an event later. Reschedule can go either way.

definition: to help someone remember to do something
example: Please remind me to send the email.
exampleEs: Por favor recuérdame enviar el correo.
cloze: Please ____ me to send the email.
note: Remind someone to do something. Remember is what YOU do yourself.

definition: to take something from someone and give it back later
example: Can I borrow your charger?
exampleEs: ¿Me prestas tu cargador?
cloze: Can I ____ your charger?
note: You borrow FROM someone. If you give it, you lend.

definition: to give something to someone for a short time
example: Could you lend me twenty pesos?
exampleEs: ¿Me podrías prestar veinte pesos?
cloze: Could you ____ me twenty pesos?
note: Irregular: lend, lent, lent. Lend is what the owner does; borrow is what you do.

definition: to use time or money on something
example: I spend about two hours a day on Discord.
exampleEs: Paso unas dos horas al día en Discord.
cloze: I ____ about two hours a day on Discord.
note: Spend time DOING something, not 'spend time to do'.

definition: to be responsible for something or someone
example: I'll take care of the invoice this afternoon.
exampleEs: Me encargo de la factura esta tarde.
cloze: I'll take ____ of the invoice this afternoon.
note: In meetings, 'I'll take care of it' is a very natural way to accept a task.

definition: to listen to or watch something carefully
example: Please pay attention to the instructions.
exampleEs: Por favor presta atención a las instrucciones.
cloze: Please pay ____ to the instructions.
note: You PAY attention, you don't 'put' or 'give' it. Then TO.

definition: to check that something is true or done
example: Make sure you save your work.
exampleEs: Asegúrate de guardar tu trabajo.
cloze: Make ____ you save your work.
note: Common at work: 'Just to make sure we're aligned...'

es: tener ganas de, esperar con ilusión
definition: to feel happy about something that will happen
example: I'm looking forward to meeting you.
exampleEs: Tengo muchas ganas de conocerte.
cloze: I'm looking ____ to meeting you.
note: The 'to' here is a preposition, so use -ing: looking forward to seeing you, NOT to see.

definition: to repair something or solve a problem
example: We need to fix this bug today.
exampleEs: Necesitamos arreglar este bug hoy.
cloze: We need to ____ this bug today.

definition: able to be trusted to work well
example: This tool is fast and reliable.
exampleEs: Esta herramienta es rápida y confiable.
cloze: This tool is fast and ____.
note: Reliable is for things and people you can trust. Opposite: unreliable.

definition: free to talk or ready to be used
example: Are you available for a quick call?
exampleEs: ¿Estás disponible para una llamada rápida?
cloze: Are you ____ for a quick call?
note: Very common in scheduling: 'Are you available at 3?'

definition: in charge of something and accountable for it
example: Who is responsible for the database?
exampleEs: ¿Quién es responsable de la base de datos?
cloze: Who is ____ for the database?
note: Responsible FOR something.

definition: feeling relaxed and not worried
example: I feel comfortable speaking English with my team.
exampleEs: Me siento cómodo hablando inglés con mi equipo.
cloze: I feel ____ speaking English with my team.
note: Pronounced KUMF-ter-bul, with three syllables.

definition: feeling shy or ashamed in front of others
example: I was embarrassed when I forgot his name.
exampleEs: Me dio vergüenza cuando olvidé su nombre.
cloze: I was ____ when I forgot his name.
note: False friend: embarrassed is NOT embarazada. It means avergonzado.

definition: used to say what is really true, often surprising
example: It looks easy, but it's actually very hard.
exampleEs: Parece fácil, pero en realidad es muy difícil.
cloze: It looks easy, but it's ____ very hard.
note: False friend: actually means en realidad, NOT actualmente. For 'actualmente' say currently or right now.

definition: after a long time or a lot of effort
example: We tried many options and eventually found a fix.
exampleEs: Probamos muchas opciones y al final encontramos una solución.
cloze: We tried many options and ____ found a fix.
note: False friend: eventually means al final, NOT eventualmente (possibly). For that say possibly or occasionally.

definition: more than usual; particularly
example: I love sci-fi, especially stories about AI.
exampleEs: Me encanta la ciencia ficción, sobre todo las historias de IA.
cloze: I love sci-fi, ____ stories about AI.
note: Spelled with an s at the start: especially, not 'specially' in formal writing.

definition: used to introduce a fact that contrasts with the main idea
example: Although I was tired, I finished the task.
exampleEs: Aunque estaba cansado, terminé la tarea.
cloze: ____ I was tired, I finished the task.
note: Never use although together with 'but' in the same sentence.

definition: used to say one thing replaces another
example: Use a loop instead of copying the code.
exampleEs: Usa un ciclo en lugar de copiar el código.
cloze: Use a loop ____ of copying the code.
note: Instead of is followed by a noun or -ing: instead of copying.

definition: something you want to achieve in the future
example: My goal is to reach B2 by March.
exampleEs: Mi meta es llegar a B2 en marzo.
cloze: My ____ is to reach B2 by March.

definition: knowledge or skill that you get from doing something
example: She has a lot of experience with Python.
exampleEs: Tiene mucha experiencia con Python.
cloze: She has a lot of ____ with Python.
note: Uncountable when it means skill from work: 'a lot of experience', not 'experiences'.

definition: an opinion about what someone should do
example: Can you give me some advice about my resume?
exampleEs: ¿Puedes darme algún consejo sobre mi currículum?
cloze: Can you give me some ____ about my resume?
note: Uncountable: some advice, a piece of advice, never 'advices'. The verb is advise.

definition: facts or details about something
example: I need more information about the contract.
exampleEs: Necesito más información sobre el contrato.
cloze: I need more ____ about the contract.
note: Uncountable: no 'informations'. Say 'a piece of information'.

definition: the time by which something must be finished
example: The deadline is next Friday, so we need to hurry.
exampleEs: La fecha límite es el próximo viernes, así que hay que apurarse.
cloze: The ____ is next Friday, so we need to hurry.
note: You MEET or MISS a deadline.

definition: money you receive every month for your job
example: My salary goes up after the first year.
exampleEs: Mi sueldo sube después del primer año.
cloze: My ____ goes up after the first year.
note: Salary is a fixed amount per month or year. Wage is usually paid per hour.

definition: a plan of when things will happen
example: Let's check the schedule before we choose a date.
exampleEs: Revisemos el calendario antes de elegir una fecha.
cloze: Let's check the ____ before we choose a date.
note: US pronunciation: SKEJ-ool.

definition: the conditions and surroundings where you live or work
example: A calm environment helps me focus.
exampleEs: Un entorno tranquilo me ayuda a concentrarme.
cloze: A calm ____ helps me focus.
note: Remember the n before the m: environment.

definition: a good result or advantage that you get from something
example: The main benefit of this tool is saving time.
exampleEs: El principal beneficio de esta herramienta es ahorrar tiempo.
cloze: The main ____ of this tool is saving time.
note: Benefit FROM something.

definition: physical or mental energy used to do something
example: Learning a language takes a lot of effort.
exampleEs: Aprender un idioma requiere mucho esfuerzo.
cloze: Learning a language takes a lot of ____.
note: You MAKE an effort or PUT IN effort. 'Do an effort' is wrong.

definition: a change that makes something better
example: There's been a big improvement in my speaking.
exampleEs: Ha habido una gran mejora en mi forma de hablar.
cloze: There's been a big ____ in my speaking.
note: Say improvement IN something.

definition: something you do regularly without thinking
example: Reading before bed is a good habit.
exampleEs: Leer antes de dormir es un buen hábito.
cloze: Reading before bed is a good ____.
note: You BREAK a bad habit and BUILD or FORM a good one.

definition: a chance to do something good
example: This job is a great opportunity to learn.
exampleEs: Este trabajo es una gran oportunidad para aprender.
cloze: This job is a great ____ to learn.
note: Opportunity TO do something, not 'opportunity of'.

definition: the way two people or groups feel and behave toward each other
example: I have a good relationship with my manager.
exampleEs: Tengo una buena relación con mi jefe.
cloze: I have a good ____ with my manager.
note: Relationship WITH someone, or BETWEEN two people.

definition: something you do wrong by accident
example: I made a mistake in the code.
exampleEs: Cometí un error en el código.
cloze: I made a ____ in the code.
note: You MAKE a mistake, not 'do' one.

definition: a choice you make after thinking
example: It was a hard decision, but I think it's right.
exampleEs: Fue una decisión difícil, pero creo que es correcta.
cloze: It was a hard ____, but I think it's right.
note: You MAKE a decision, not 'take' it, in US English.

definition: as much as is needed
example: I don't have enough time to finish.
exampleEs: No tengo suficiente tiempo para terminar.
cloze: I don't have ____ time to finish.
note: Enough comes BEFORE a noun (enough time) but AFTER an adjective (good enough).
